Fresh final whole-change assessment after all four implementation milestones and their required corrections, distinct from every previous milestone assessment. Complete delivered range e78bc3943d37092bd92997a2c9f06ea9d126e223..38735541b01cb80745be993ad98025c375393f2a; engineering head f80bb3ff7f892fe8930d7fe07327ae460c28ff8b and later attributed workflow/review bookkeeping. Engineering scope is 281 paths:148 surviving subjects and133 deletions. The deletion inventory below preserves baseline identities; missing paths have no invented current identity. Unrelated untracked archives are excluded. Current approved Proposal, three-model Design and Delivery member identities match the inspected basis. Earlier milestone judgments inform history and concern disposition but do not substitute for this fresh composed assessment.

Integrated scope and contract: reviewed the shared transport/parser extraction through v2-only recording, factual discovery, runtime/caller retirement, archive separation, test dispositions, current public procedures and generated delivery. Six explicitly selected stored formats are retired, while the separate document marker, targeted transport, advanced result envelope and configuration versions remain. Owner-confirmed completed legacy work and operational v2 are attributed baseline decisions, not execution proof. No migration, archive conversion, temporary reader, new lifecycle stage, v2 orchestration, schema redesign or historical release rebuilding is authorized. Actual archive bytes and historical metadata are preserved.

Recording and discovery: neutral transport validation retains closed shapes independently of stored version; current store selection remains v2-only. Explicit root classification, manifest discrimination and registered complete-set validation preserve fail-closed current malformed records. Journal.version2 plus saved manifests/writes/read-set governs recovery, including initial creation without a current manifest; version1/unknown/inconsistent basis and third-state content reject without destructive recovery. Concurrent/retried targeted and advanced writes retain revision/read conflict, immutable origins and atomic persistence. Discovery schema2 returns factual candidates and complete/incomplete scope, never workflow readiness. Limits are inclusive; reserved current files, duplicate manifests, malformed/unknown JSON and invalid paths cannot become archives. Coalesced normalized diagnostics now preserve public rejected output and useful partial candidates without exposing invalid names.

Cross-consumer correction found: the public Python review validator rejects stored roots, but the retained automation assessment helper _canonical_review_occurrence bypasses that boundary by calling lower-level review/log parsers directly. A fresh read-only execution accepted an approved architecture review from a real archived change.yaml root. This creates current canonical assessment evidence from retired stored input, contrary to the approved outside-stored-input limit. It is consumed by retained stage-native assessment and automation readiness/correction helpers; rejecting StateStore construction alone does not guard the independently callable helper. This assessment does not claim a successful end-to-end automated run or a storage mutation. The demonstrated old-input acceptance is enough to require a narrow caller-boundary correction and regression; no broad retirement of standalone review/calibration grammar is requested.

Python and archive boundaries otherwise: removed engines/activation/exclusive wrappers have no surviving imports into the public Node dispatch. Retained project YAML parsing is generic and not a legacy record decoder. Document/model markers and normalized JSON owner placement remain document checks, without reading or approving a store. Current feature validation does not require a retired sibling test spec, while explicitly supplied proof maps still validate. Baseline discovery skips archival docs/changes Markdown before decoding, while explicitly selected current roots still receive complete-set validation. The malformed-archive local/exact-revision regression demonstrates this distinction. Separate pure policy, receipt, calibration, cache and release behavior remains scoped; directly affected stored-input callers need the same separation, which the identified helper currently misses.

Public semantic review: descriptions, triggers, prerequisites, exact reads and writes, packaged references, stop conditions, assessment independence, claim limits and handoffs preserve specialist methods. Route does not revive another assessor's judgment; final whole-change Code Review remains mandatory before distinct success-only Verify. The corrected manual-proof procedure records pre-Verify evidence in registered v2 evidence and successful Verify references it, avoiding both the retired Markdown sidecar and a circular success prerequisite. The obsolete final-readiness heading parenthetical is removed without changing procedure. Current canonical resources, built mirrors, three current archives and candidate metadata agree through actual regeneration/parity/install proof. Prior releases and archive records retain their original meaning. External PR/release authority stays separate.

Test maintenance: removals are justified by explicitly decontracted runtime capabilities and replaced current rejection/safety proof, not by age, similar names or lower test counts. Synthetic v2 storage fixtures retain publication/recovery/origin/collision protection. Public retired-command checks cover rejection and absence of mutation/log side effects. Existing standalone review grammar/policy tests remain useful; however they and constructor rejection tests do not expose the helper's archived-input acceptance. The two later removed static review tests mixed enduring policy terms with retired Markdown operational strings; enduring protections remain in current schema and skill tests, rather than every removed assertion being labeled useless. No blanket restoration of thirteen previously removed historical suites is required by this assessment.

Validation evidence and applicability: current durable evidence provides exact commands, results and protection maps. The complete PR-range selection ran33 checks successfully against e78bc394..d17147c23e2eecd1250edcaf21242ebbce446cd3, including lifecycle snapshot validation121.02s. Later EOF-only edits have independently inspected trailing-byte scope, unchanged Python AST, JS syntax check, fresh Node400 and installed npm7. The later Verify heading/current candidate regeneration has fresh complete skill356, builder7, installed npm7, canonical/build checks, adapter validation and exact source/resource/candidate parity3. Earlier full adapter158 mechanics are reused only for unchanged machinery; new generated content has fresh parity/install proof. These are actual distinct execution bases, not a blanket claim of a new full33 run on f80. Prior failed historical activation audit, intermediate manual-proof/selector failures, timeout and short-SHA invocation errors remain disclosed, not converted into passes. The fresh helper reproduction is contrary semantic evidence despite the passing selected suites.

Checklist dispositions: (1) spec alignment concern at retained helper stored-input boundary; (2) coverage concern for that untested path; (3) edge cases concern for archived review plus retained helper composition; (4) error handling concern because rejection is bypassed; (5) architecture boundaries concern limited to that bypass, otherwise neutral transport/representation/assessment separation holds; (6) compatibility concern limited to unintended old stored-input acceptance, with archives and independent version domains otherwise preserved; (7) security/privacy pass on reviewed paths, no secret disclosure or mutation demonstrated; (8) derived currency pass with exact changed-resource proof and explicit mechanics reuse; (9) scope containment pass, unrelated archives/release history preserved; (10) validation evidence pass as honestly scoped evidence, but it does not negate the demonstrated defect. Necessary authority and assessable evidence are available; the defect has a defined implementation-owned correction.

Required handoff: implementation owner corrects the affected Python assessment boundary and proves retired/current stored roots cannot be accepted through helper/caller paths while standalone grammar remains supported. Responsible independent rereview must assess correction and renew adequate complete integrated final judgment. No engineering, routing, milestone or upstream evidence was edited by this reviewer. No remaining planned implementation milestone was pending at review entry; this newly discovered correction prevents final reliance. Verify readiness, branch readiness and PR readiness are not claimed; Verify remains a separate later assessment.
